rows.heading: Communications and Media Studies
rows.method: COBI overnight review, approved by Sam Lee:  Do not fold to CMST (Communication Studies). 2023-24 SAC catalog lists Communications & Media Studies (CMSD) as its own program (CMSD 102, 105, 298B Designing for Print and Digital Media, etc.). CMST courses are public speaking/interpersonal communication.
